# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 106 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 106

Jesus said: "When you make the two one, you will become sons of man, and when you say: 'Mountain, move away!' it will move."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- "Make the two one" — the unification theme central to Thomas (cf. Sayings 4, 11, 22)
- "Sons of man" / **ϣⲏⲣⲉ ⲙⲣⲱⲙⲉ** — becomes son(s) of the human being; possibly "son of Man" (messianic title) or "children of humanity" (generic)
- "Mountain, move away!" — parallel to Matthew 17:20 / 21:21 / Mark 11:23; faith moving mountains
- The result of unification (*monachos*) is both ontological (becoming sons of Man) and miraculous (mountain-moving)
- Cross-reference: Saying 48 ("if two make peace with each other in a single house, they will say to the mountain: move away, and it will move")
